messages:
alex_k: Quick check — I'm about to run the throughput harness for the CB heuristics tweak (max_batch_tokens -> 64k, queue_window_ms -> 30). Wanted to ping owners in case it needs a canary before dedicated rigs.

maya_r: thanks for the heads up. which model / seq len profile are you using?

alex_k: running gptx-14b, mix of 2-1024 seq (50% < 128). workload sends many short requests so batch fill is low. config I'm trying:
```
cb.max_batch_tokens=65536
cb.queue_window_ms=30
cb.max_concurrent_batches=4
cb.small_batch_fallback=true
```

chris_p: can you add --trace=queue to the run so we can get per-batch enqueue times? also drop a loadgen scenario id so I can correlate.

alex_k: yes --trace=queue. scenario id cb-edgecase-2026-03-17

bench-bot: run queued: id=cb-edgecase-2026-03-17, nodes=6, p95 target=30ms, seed=20260317-1

sasha_ml: small thought — if small_batch_fallback is true we'll see more small batches but lower latency. want to compare token-cost delta. can you capture token counts per batch too (trace includes kv cache sizes?)

alex_k: trace contains batch.token_count, batch.kv_hit_ratio; will post artifacts. planning 3 runs: baseline (old params), tweak A (64k, 30ms), tweak B (32k, 50ms)

liam_ops: heads-up on infra: the dedicated pool has a maintenance window at 03:40 UTC, avoid scheduling long runs overlapping that. maybe do early run now.

maya_r: if you need quick profile, I can grab perf counters (gpu_util, smem) during run. ping me when started.

alex_k: started run 1 (baseline) now — posting trace when done.

bench-bot: run started: cb-edgecase-2026-03-17:baseline @ 2791234675

alex_k: done with baseline. p95 tokens/time looks fine but noticed a tail of ~6% requests stuck in queue >120ms. attaching minimal snippet:
```
queue_stats: total=120k, >120ms=7200 (6%), avg_wait=18ms
```

chris_p: interesting. can you grep for requests with large prompt sizes? maybe a small fraction with long seqs causing head-of-line blocking.

alex_k: grep shows 0.4% requests > 2048 tokens but they line up with the >120ms samples. also saw batch.token_count spikes to 50k occasionally.

sasha_ml: next run can we try bumping max_concurrent_batches to 6 and reduce queue_window_ms to 20? might reduce head-of-line for mixed seq.

maya_r: also consider enabling prefix KV caching for repeated short queries in the scenario.

alex_k: starting tweak A (64k/30ms) now. will enable --trace=queue,--trace=tokens

bench-bot: run started: cb-edgecase-2026-03-17:tweakA @ 2791234770

alex_k: quick q — who can review a small CR to change cb heuristic to prefer smaller max_batch_tokens when short_request_ratio>0.6? cr link: https://git.redwood.dev/r/infra/1234

chris_p: i'll take a look in ~30m

liam_ops: FYI, I bumped node reclaim timeout to 45s to avoid early preemption during batching tests.

alex_k: tweak A finished. queue tail dropped to 2%, avg_wait 12ms. cost per token slightly up but overall p95 latency improved.

maya_r: can you upload traces + a summary table (baseline vs tweakA vs tweakB planned)? i'll run perf counters next and compare.

alex_k: uploading now: s3://bench-results/cb-edgecase-2026-03-17/ (baseline.json, tweakA.json)

chris_p: reviewed CR, left 2 nits about comments. overall LGTM.

alex_k: thanks all. follow-ups: run tweak B tomorrow morning (avoid maintenance), create a small regression test to assert queue tail <3% on this scenario, and I'll send a short write-up for runtime sync.

sasha_ml: sounds good. great debugging session :thumbsup:

alex_k: closing for now — thanks everyone. will ping once tweakB completes.
